notes.title: Virus Launch!
notes.content:
Welcome to Virus in Early Access! 

First off, thank you tremendously for your support and interest in the game! Development has been a lot of fun and hard work, so it's extremely exciting to finally release the first iteration of Virus to the public!

Moving forward - pending a stable and successful launch for everyone - Virus will continue to be updated and improved regularly. 

Community involvement is essential to the evolution of Virus. The best place to provide feedback, make suggestions, report bugs, etc. is on the Official Virus Discord server. The link to the server can be accessed by "Visit the website" on the Virus Store Page. It is also in the store page description, as well as in the game itself under "Notes". Don't hesitate to get involved so you can not only help the game, but also make friends and build an awesome new VR community!

If Discord is not good for you, feel free to provide the same kind of feedback in the Disucssions area of the Virus Community Hub!

Please keep in mind this is V1.0.0 of Early Access. Any bugs or issues that may be discovered will be actively pursued and fixed. 

Thanks again for your support!

- Patrick (Virus Dev)
